name: Acquia DAM - Enhanced integration links
description: Registers more accurate integration links on Acquia DAM
project_description:
Drupal integration with Acquia DAM 
 Acquia DAM is a cloud-based digital asset management solution that seamlessly integrates with the Acquia digital experience platform. Acquia DAM allows marketers to connect their visual content – like graphics, logos, photos, videos, presentations, PDF documents, and more – for greater visibility and brand consistency across their digital experiences. . These assets can then be delivered downstream to the Acquia Platform for creating dynamic, personalized experiences.

 Real-time asset synchronization via Webhooks 
 To keep your media perfectly up to date, the module supports webhooks integration for real-time asset synchronization. This feature triggers automated, instantaneous updates between Acquia DAM and Drupal site whenever assets are modified, or deleted, eliminating syncing delays.

 Migrate from Media: Acquia DAM to Acquia DAM 
 In response to customer demand, we've added the download/sync functionality from the legacy Acquia DAM module to 1.1.0 and above! If you get the latest version of Media: Acquia DAM, there is a migration tool that seamlessly updates your media types to use this module all while maintaining the rest of your integrations.

Note: this migration tool is in beta (4/1/2025) -- please test it out and if you run into issues we're pretty responsive in the issue queue.
